name: Band-Assisted Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Anchor the middle of a resistance band low behind you and loop its ends evenly around the ab wheel axle clear of the wheel.
Kneel with both hands gripping the handles directly beneath your shoulders, abs braced and glutes squeezed.
Roll forward as the band lengthens, letting your hips and shoulders move together toward a straight line.
Press down into the handles and pull the wheel smoothly back beneath your shoulders, controlling the rebound as the band shortens.
tips: Anchor the band straight behind you so it pulls evenly along your path.
Stop rolling out before your lower back begins to sag toward the floor.
